limitations: contract:SOW-VEL-2022 has contract_clause_judgment candidate tuples but no admitted WORLD dispositions; SOW is excluded from acquisition and dependency derivations via diligence_active_contract policy.

identity_judgment and contract_clause_judgment dispositions are read from _tv_groundings WORLD detail (obligation_id:DISPOSITION); tuples without such grounding are omitted from epistemic derivations.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical filter; no unresolved disposition. Invoice is open iff billing source status equals 'open'.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over invoice_status universe represented in world.sqlite.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT invoice_id FROM invoice_status WHERE status = 'open'
derivations.required_premise: invoice_status tuple exists for each represented invoice.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical date filter; no unresolved disposition. Contract is stated expired when an explicit expiry date falls in a past calendar year represented in the expiry text.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: PARTIAL: only contracts with contract_expiry_date tuples are candidates; MSAs without explicit expiry are not inferred expired.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT contract_id FROM contract_expiry_date WHERE expiry matches a past year pattern (2019-2023).
derivations.required_premise: contract_expiry_date tuple when contract text states an explicit past expiry.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose policy over WORLD facts. Active when document is not (kind=sow AND contract_stated_expired). Expired SOW is explicitly not active; MSAs without expiry remain active.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every contract referent has contract_document_kind; contract_stated_expired may be empty for non-expired contracts.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT contract_id FROM contract_document_kind cdk LEFT JOIN contract_stated_expired cse ON cse.contract_id = cdk.contract_id WHERE NOT (cdk.kind = 'sow' AND cse.contract_id IS NOT NULL)
derivations.required_premise: contract_document_kind for each contract referent in scope.
optional_enrichment: contract_expiry_date for finer-grained expiry reasoning (not required when SOW expired tuple exists)

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose A policy. Contract qualifies when active under diligence_active_contract AND at least one allowed acquisition-relevant clause kind has disposition PRESENT. ABSENT or UNRESOLVED clause judgments do not qualify.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: contract_clause_judgment tuples exist for each (contract, kind) candidate; only PRESENT dispositions contribute.
derivations.deterministic_computation: JOIN diligence_active_contract to contract_clause_judgment WHERE kind IN purpose_a allowed_kinds AND disposition = PRESENT
derivations.required_premise: diligence_active_contract membership and at least one PRESENT acquisition-relevant clause judgment.
optional_enrichment: contract_counterparty_name for human-readable reporting (not used in qualification predicate)
blocking_unresolved_state: contract_clause_judgment UNRESOLVED for all allowed acquisition kinds on a contract prevents that contract from qualifying
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED between billing and contract does not block contract qualification; it affects purpose A association output only

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose C policy. Emit (counterparty, contract) for each active contract with at least one PRESENT obligation kind from {exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term}. Status dependent requires confident billing-contract SAME_ENTITY identity AND current commercial relationship (open invoice OR auto_renewal OR rolling_term PRESENT on active contract).
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Row emitted for each active contract with a declared PRESENT obligation kind, including rows withheld as unresolved when billing-contract identity is UNRESOLVED.
derivations.deterministic_computation: For each diligence_active_contract with PRESENT purpose-C obligation kinds: resolve billing-contract identity; gather open invoices via SAME_ENTITY; set status dependent or unresolved per conjunction policy.
derivations.required_premise: diligence_active_contract, PRESENT contract_clause_judgment for at least one purpose-C obligation kind.
optional_enrichment: crm/registry identifiers via SAME_ENTITY component for counterparty rendering when identity is confident
blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED on billing:… ~ contract:… forces status unresolved and withholds open_invoice_ids linkage
non_blocking_unresolved_state: contract_clause_judgment UNRESOLVED for non-qualifying kinds does not block the row when another obligation kind is PRESENT
identity_judgment UNRESOLVED between registry candidates does not block dependency row emission when billing-contract link is SAME_ENTITY

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose A contractual_revenue_exposure. Include each represented invoice joined to an acquisition_relevant_contract via a recorded billing-contract identity_judgment candidate pair. association=asserted when disposition SAME_ENTITY; association=unresolved when UNRESOLVED. DISTINCT pairs are excluded from inclusion.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every represented invoice on a qualifying contract or requiring unresolved association reporting is included; sorted by invoice_id ascending.
derivations.deterministic_computation: JOIN invoices to acquisition_relevant_contracts through billing: billed_name; map SAME_ENTITY->asserted, UNRESOLVED->unresolved; strip invoice:/contract: prefixes in output.
derivations.required_premise: Invoice mechanical fields, acquisition_relevant_contract membership, billing-contract identity_judgment tuple.
optional_enrichment: contract_counterparty_name for display alignment (not used to infer association)
blocking_unresolved_state: contract_clause_judgment UNRESOLVED for all acquisition kinds prevents contract from appearing in acquisition_relevant_contract and thus excludes related invoices
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED on billing-contract pair includes invoice with association=unresolved rather than omitting it

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose B counterparty_reconciliation. Emit every admitted identity_judgment with epistemic SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED. Pairs oriented class_rank (billing < contract < crm < registry); sorted by left then right.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: All 38 required cross-system identity links admitted in world.sqlite with WORLD groundings.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT left, right, disposition FROM identity_judgment groundings; canonicalize orientation; sort lexicographically.
derivations.required_premise: identity_judgment tuple with admitted WORLD disposition for each required link.
optional_enrichment: Mechanical name relations for human audit only; never used to infer epistemic status
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED is a first-class output epistemic value, not a derivation blocker

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose C commercial_dependency. One row per active contract with PRESENT obligation kind. status=dependent when billing-contract SAME_ENTITY and current-relationship conjunction holds; status=unresolved when billing-contract identity is UNRESOLVED. obligation_kinds sorted subset of enum; open_invoice_ids only when identity is confident.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Row for each contract-counterparty candidate under purpose C policy including unresolved rows; sorted by contract_id ascending.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Materialize commercial_dependency_row policy; render counterparty in purpose-B identifier forms; strip contract:/invoice: prefixes.
derivations.required_premise: diligence_active_contract, PRESENT purpose-C obligation kind, billing-contract identity_judgment.
optional_enrichment: Prefer crm: counterparty when SAME_ENTITY component exists; fall back to billing: when identity unresolved
blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED on billing-contract pair forces status unresolved and empty open_invoice_ids
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED between registry candidates does not change status when billing-contract is SAME_ENTITY
contract_clause_judgment UNRESOLVED for rolling_term does not block row when exclusivity or auto_renewal is PRESENT
